controller force far below limit so not saturated
3 steps before violation cart already at 2.359 moving outward at 1.34 m/s

counterfactual.change: Set initial v from 0.306 to 0.0 (single field) - removes initial outward kinetic energy that controller fails to dissipate; with same steps/plant, cart never reaches track end.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and clean sensors; cart starts at x=0.437 with positive velocity 0.307 m/s. State-feedback controller gains adapted to plant (heavy pole 0.289kg, long pole 0.905m) provide insufficient position regulation: controller force stays ~0.85-0.87 N far below 65.7 N limit, while velocity remains ~1.34-1.37 m/s. Pole remains near upright (theta ~0.08 rad, margin ~0.71 rad) so pole_upright not triggering correction. Cart monotonically drifts outward until x=2.404 at step 261 exceeds |x|<=2.4. Counterfactual zeroing initial velocity prevents energy buildup and track exit, proving initial kinetic condition plus weak position feedback causes violation.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart carrying the upright pole drifts steadily rightward toward the track edge across steps 258-261 while the pole stays balanced. By step 261 the cart reaches the far right limit of the track, indicating a cart_in_track excursion rather than a pole fall.
